justifications.fit: the module's receipt idiom and the nova.media painters are followed in the new figure, but two emitted field names misstate their contents (benchmarks/solve_program_size_gate.py:2164-2165 and :2170), so a reader must work out each from the source.
justifications.goal_fidelity: benchmarks/solve_program_size_gate.py:2773 runs each certificate row as its own child process by default and the committed receipt shows all four rows complete with distinct child pids, bounding what one process accumulates rather than proving headroom for larger rows.
justifications.scope_discipline: both commits touch only the five declared paths, and the docs/plans/cpu-compile-abort.html diff carries the new landing section with no meta-line change.
